messages:
maria: pushed a narrow‑width mock for billing called 'compact scope toggle' https://redwood.design/p/compact-scope :eyes:
aj: looks good. quick Q: does switching scope keep time range and token denom? I couldn't tell.
sam: noticed switching resets denom to USD — super jarring for token‑first users. can we persist denom per user or at least per session? :thinking:
kyle: a11y: legend swatches drop below 4:1 in dark theme (~3.6:1). change BG to token‑neutral‑300. scope toggle needs an explicit aria‑label.
olivia: invoice CTA should be contextual: 'Download project invoice' vs 'Download org invoice'. non‑admins should see disabled CTA with tooltip 'billing access required'.
billing-bot: FYI invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and 403 for users without billing perms. UI should map to friendly states: 'Invoice not available yet' or 'Access restricted'. avoid raw codes.
aj: layout proposal: left rail sticky token breakdown on desktop, collapsed token drawer on mobile. persist collapse state per user. debounce scope changes by 200ms to avoid chart thrash.
maria: action list: 1) persist denom per user/session (sam) 2) contextual invoice CTA + disabled tooltip (olivia) 3) a11y contrast + aria fixes (kyle) 4) left‑rail desktop, collapsed drawer mobile + persisted state (aj) 5) map invoice errors to friendly copy (aj + billing‑bot). I'll update Figma and push a tiny A/B for desktop tomorrow. :thumbsup:
